titles.title: จอมเวทคนเลี้ยงแกะ

description:
Born into a world where divine power defines status, Turan hides his true strength to live as a simple shepherd. Descended from a line of wizards yet raised in secrecy, he avoids the attention of powerful nobles who would exploit him. But when a wandering knight recognizes his extraordinary potential, Turan is faced with a life-changing choice. Will he remain in hiding, or journey to the capital and embrace the destiny he was meant for?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: คืนวันใต้ปราการ

description:
Seo-U always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Won-Hyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seo-U must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he’s been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: แบดบอยมานี่มา!
ผมจะเป็นแบดบอย

description:
Su-Yeon has a weakness for bad boys, a lingering habit from her toxic ex, Hui-Ju. While her current boyfriend, Je-Hyeon, is sweet and gentle, Su-Yeon feels a strange sense of dissatisfaction. When Hui-Ju suddenly reappears as her new team leader, Su-Yeon makes an impulsive wish—and the impossible happens. Overnight, Je-Hyeon transforms into the edgy bad boy of her dreams. But there’s a twist: when she arrives at work the next day, her "bad boy" ex has turned into a perfect gentleman. Between her bad boyfriend and good ex, Su-Yeon’s life gets complicated.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: พนักงานใหม่ผู้เคยเป็นนักรบ

description:
Reborn in South Korea in 2026, former hero Yong Sa-Jun struggles to adjust to a world without magic or dragons. After surviving a brutal job market, he finally lands a position at a major corporation - only to come face to face with the man he once loved in his past life: the prince he failed to save. Haunted by memories of tragedy, Sa-Jun tries to keep his distance. But when he discovers that the prince has been cursed, Sa-Jun resolves to save him once again…even if it means juggling deadlines and danger alike!

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 推しと一ヶ月暮らしてみたら

description:
Rookie actor Yeo Jeong-Won just landed a spot on the healing reality show A Month in Europe. There’s just one problem: his ultimate celebrity crush, Kwon Hae-Woon, is his co-star! To survive the trip, Jeong-Won has two simple rules: don’t let anyone know he’s a superfan, and don't get too close to Hae-Woon. But when Hae-Woon insists on being roommates and claims they’ve met before, Jeong-Won’s "professional" act begins to crumble. Between shared rooms and constant filming, he’s one $5-a-month fan-app notification away from being outed as the world’s biggest fanboy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Because of a difficult family background, Ji-U enters college later than most of her peers. Quiet and reserved, she keeps to the edges of campus life, always feeling one step out of sync with everyone else. There is one person she cannot help noticing, U-Yeon, a boy who seems to shine wherever he goes. He stands at the center of every group, laughing easily, drawing people in without effort. Compared to him, Ji-U feels invisible, and so she hides her feelings, nursing a silent crush she believes will never reach him. To Ji-U, U-Yeon appears flawless, someone untouched by hardship or pain. But one rainy day, that illusion shatters. Ji-U stumbles upon U-Yeon standing alone in the downpour, tears mixing with rain as he cries with heartbreaking beauty. In that moment, Ji-U realizes that even the brightest people carry unseen scars. And perhaps her quiet presence could become a place of comfort for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Living in the slums of District Zero, Ban runs a small errand service, taking on jobs others would rather avoid. One day, he accepts a request from Shinwi, the boss of a rising criminal organization, and stumbles upon the existence of the mysterious “Project W.” While investigating the substance, Ban hopes to help Ray, the police officer who once took him in and whom he has secretly loved for years. But the deeper Ban digs, the more he uncovers a hidden truth Ray has long been keeping hidden. As secrets surface, Ban finds himself caught between loyalty, love, and a dangerous conspiracy. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Once a promising athlete, Yoon-Bin is ready to give up after repeated injuries shatter his dreams. At his lowest point, a mysterious man with a tiger tattoo gives him the strength to stand again. Years later, after retiring as a gold medalist and becoming a taekwondo instructor, Yoon-Bin unexpectedly reunites with Kwon Young, an underworld boss and the man who saved his life. Haunted by his past, Young pushes Yoon-Bin away, convinced he brings only harm. But Yoon-Bin refuses to let go, because now it is his turn to become Young’s light.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Former kendo prodigy Jae-Hyeok has lost his way, spiraling far from his golden days. The only person capable of reining him in is Yeong-Won, a steadfast police officer with a heart of gold. Though they couldn’t be more different, these single fathers find their back into each other's lives. As Jae-Hyeok moves in to learn the ropes of parenting, his Alpha instincts awaken, blurring the lines between duty and desire in a domestic whirlwind romance.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Errand service owner Wu Hyeon-Do never expected his first love to walk back into his life, especially not like this. Seong Su arrives clutching a flyer for a suspicious cult, claiming his dead son might still be alive. Reeling from the sudden mention of a child he never knew about, Hyeon-Do assumes Seong Su must have moved on and built a family after he left the island. But the truth is far more shocking than he could have realized...

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: คืนจันทร์ละมุน

description:
In a sleepy rural village, the local piano academy is a picture of peace...until the sun sets. Seonwu Jin is the academy’s exhausted instructor, living as the "wife" of the charismatic village head, Goh Hui-Jae. But the domestic bliss is a deadly front. Jin is an undercover cop on a high-stakes surveillance mission, and Hui-Jae is the ruthless mob boss who vanished after a bloody power struggle. By day, Jin plays the perfect partner; by night, he does power to ensure he isn't made. But as the organization closes in, the lines between his cover and the truth begin to bleed. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 液祓い〜ペントハウスのその中で〜

description:
At a remarkably young age, Choi Mu-Jin has already ascended to the prestigious position of second-in-command within the notorious national syndicate, 'Weolha Organization.' While he is a figure of intense envy and admiration among his subordinates, Mu-Jin carries a burden no one else suspects, a hidden, degrading mission assigned by the Chairman himself. Every week under the cover of darkness, he is sent to extract semen from Baek Wu-Yeon, the Chairman’s secluded ""human talisman"" kept hidden away from the world. 

Inside the suffocating luxury of a high-end penthouse, the command is always the same: ""Suck it."" The moment Wu-Yeon’s lips part, Mu-Jin’s autonomy vanishes entirely. Faced with an order he is powerless to refuse, Mu-Jin finds himself trapped in a cycle of duty and desire. Can he successfully carry out his visceral task tonight, or will the weight of this secret finally break him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 酸いも渋いも～出会いはキャンディーのように～

description:
Ji-Won just wants to enjoy a steamy one-night stand, but the neighbor from hell keeps killing the mood. After nights of listening to a heartbroken stranger wail breakup anthems through the walls, Ji-Won finally storms next door to demand silence. Instead of a typical nuisance, he finds Hyeon watching a cringey, viral video of Ji-Won’s most cringe college memory. Now that his secret "black history" is out, things are about to get a lot more sour - and a little bit spicy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Bearing the traitor’s brand, Se-un Tang spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. The Demon Smith stands before the anvil once more to forge a path tempered in vengeance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: If You Can't Date, You Die!
If You Don't Date, You Die!
Nếu Không Hẹn Hò, Bạn Sẽ Chết!
เดตไม่ได้ก็ตายซะ!

description:
Ju-Gyeong is a powerhouse Chief Producer who has never felt a single spark of true love. But her life shatters when a rogue celestial’s forbidden arrow strikes her by mistake. Consumed by a supernatural fever, she stumbles into the arms of Hyeon-U. One look at him is all it takes for the curse to ignite, forcing a desperate confession to a total stranger. Now, Ju-Gyeong must navigate a cutthroat industry and a vengeful executive director. In a world where a cold heart leads to a cold grave, can she turn a forced obsession into a love worth living for?

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: The Postman Walking Through the Apocalypse
The Postman Who Walks the Apocalypse
บุรุษไปรษณีย์วันสิ้นโลก

description:
Jeong-Guk Woo delivers mail as a postman in a post-apocalyptic world and dreams of riding the subway. When headquarters announces plans to revive it, Jeong-Guk is eager to join, but government worker Yong-Han Cho personally bans him, citing the lack of dangerous missions in Jeong-Guk’s file. Infuriated by the snub, Jeong-Guk accepts the deadly task of delivering a letter to the AAA, a militarized area infamous for refusing mail. Once he arrives, he discovers the letter is addressed to Yong-Han's sisters, who beg him to help them escape. Will he follow the postman rules, or risk everything to help them?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

For as long as he can remember, Yun Jeong-Wu has been the backbone of his struggling family, working tirelessly to support a younger brother plagued by chronic illness. During those long, grueling years, Jeong-Wu happened upon a newspaper feature about a prodigious young Baduk player named Cha Ji-Han. Perhaps it was because Ji-Han shared his brother’s age, or because the athlete had successfully overcome his own past health struggles, but Jeong-Wu found himself projecting his brother’s image onto the boy, eventually becoming his most devoted fan. 

Years later, Jeong-Wu has secured a position as the youngest staff member at a professional photography studio. It is there that he finally comes face-to-face with his idol, who has now expanded his career into modeling. The professional reunion takes a dark, bewildering turn that night. After a staff dinner, a drowsy Jeong-Wu retreats to his bedroom, only to be jolted awake by the sensation of wandering hands. Terrified, he stares into the darkness at the intruder. "Ch-Cha Ji-Han?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yoo-Ju is forced to steal her twin sister's identity and enter a marriage of convenience. But Seung-Han Do, the chaebol heir she's meant to deceive, sees through her charade from the very beginning. Instead of exposing her, he finds himself enthralled by her dangerous game.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: Cuando la vida te da tomates
Quand la vie te donne des tomates
นายแก้มแดงของคุณอัลฟ่า

description:
By day, Jin Ho-Rang works as a janitor. By night, he picks up extra shifts at a club, scraping by while doing his best to stay cheerful. So when he suddenly receives a marriage proposal from the parent of his high school crush, Cha Ah-Jo, he can hardly believe it. Back then, Ah-jo was a beautiful omega who seemed to shine like a flower. Ho-Rang is told that Ah-Jo’s health declined after a single reckless night the two once shared, and that this is why the family is pushing for the marriage. Expecting a fragile and delicate figure from his memories, Ho-Rang goes to meet him again. Instead, he finds a towering, wildly different man who barely resembles the gentle Ah-Jo he once knew. Caught between nostalgia, shock, and an unexpected new dynamic, Ho-Rang is pulled into a whirlwind engagement that is nothing like what he imagined, turning his quiet life into a chaotic and heartfelt romantic comedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Once sorta passionate lovers, Ha-Sol and Jin-Yul are now nothing more than each other's "exes." After completing his mandatory military service and returning to university, Jin-Yul unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha-Sol on campus. Uncomfortable with the awkward baggage of their shared history, Jin-Yul does everything in his power to avoid his former flame. However, destiny takes a bizarre and terrifying turn when a malicious ghost—one that had been relentlessly stalking Jin-Yul—takes complete possession of Ha-Sol's body. 

Driven by the spirit's dark, uninhibited desires, the boundary between the supernatural and the carnal quickly dissolves. Trapped together by this paranormal anomaly, the former couple finds themselves pushed into an intense, feverish intimacy, crossing boundaries and indulging in raw, physical acts they never even dared to attempt back when they were actually dating. Their unresolved past colliding with possession sparks an uncontrollable, forbidden fire between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Jongno-Gu. One day when I was four, my father's death notice arrived. My father, who claimed to come from an empire called Talochium and was the strongest paladin, left me behind.

 *"If you wish, I'll send you back. To where you were born. To where you should have been. To where that man still lives."*

The last chance offered by the mysterious lifeform that appeared from my father's keepsake box. Now I can save him, right? But... 

The father from the past I finally reunited with seems a little off somehow. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The rising star Eun Do-Hyeon who instantly grabbed attention. His rapid growth and exceptional skills, surpassing his peers, drew uncomfortable stares before cheers. Lacking both awareness and social skills, he constantly clashes within the team. In a world where talent alone isn't enough. The brighter his talent shines, the more tangled his relationships become...

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:
Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn’t look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl’s face sends Jinyong’s happy little circuits into overdrive...

*Source: Naver, translated*

At the edge of a distant continent, a land perpetually blanketed in snow lies Oldenland, ruled by Archduke Giesel Zvendard. His cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and even the bizarre rumor that he carries the blood of monsters make everyone fear him. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is simply a peaceful daily life, immersed in magical research with a warm cup of tea in his quiet study. What shattered this modest wish was an unexpected bride from the southernmost tip of Cornia. Rensley Mallosen, the bastard son of Cornia, appeared wearing a bride's crown in place of his runaway sister. His brief attempt to hide, fearing discovery, was short-lived. This cheerful, chatty knight, his sun-like golden hair flowing as he roamed the castle, kept stirring up small disturbances in the ice castle that seemed destined for eternal silence. Even though he should have been driven out immediately for this fraudulent marriage, Giesel found himself increasingly unable to look away from Rensley, who beamed brightly and chattered away at even the smallest kindness. Rensley, who had been rejected from the moment he was born and ultimately abandoned, arriving in Oldenland, began to harbor affection for Giesel's seemingly indifferent yet kind demeanor. But the moment he became aware of his feelings, the time for parting drew near...

To Oldenland, the coldest land on the continent, yet where the warmest things gather, will Rensley ever be able to return?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A Russian mafia boss is attacked in an assassination attempt. This betrayal, driven by a power grab within the organization, brings the entire crime syndicate to the brink of collapse. Ovcharka Boris stands before the blood of his closest friend and makes his choice: revenge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Born gay, born single Kang Woo-Jin. He's been secretly in love with Choi Yi-Tae, the transfer student he met in his second year of high school, all the way to his current age of thirty. Kang Woo-Jin couldn't betray the friendship he shared with Choi Yi-Tae during their youthful days, convincing himself it was okay to remain just friends. But when Choi Yi-Tae starts pestering him to move in together, Kang Woo-Jin finds himself facing an unavoidable dilemma.

 *“I'm gay.”

“What does you being gay have to do with us living together?”*

Dragged into cohabitation, Kang Woo-Jin begins living with him. Months later, an incident finally pushes him past the line of friendship.

 *“Kang Woo-Jin, how do you have sex with a guy?”*

There was no way he knew. He'd tried with other men, but never followed through. He could only think of this guy right in front of him. It had been 13 years of unrequited love. Now that we've crossed the line of friendship, what exactly are we?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

titles.title: The Man Next Door Who Kills Me

description:
*“What?? You think I like you?? Wh-where did this all go wrong??”*

The start of her first heart-pounding solo living experience, and the first day of the new semester—she ran into that bully-like guy, Kim Jun. After narrowly escaping a crisis where she almost got killed(?) by Kim Jun, who mistakenly thought she was following him, Yeon-Hui desperately prayed she'd never have to face that bully again. But then, the bully Kim Jun appeared again in the same apartment building, right next door. Same school, same club too! My head hurts because of this guy next door who acts like he wants to kill me. But then, out of nowhere, that bully Kim Jun suddenly changes and starts getting close to Yeon-Hui...?! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

My first love, Ju A-Rin, whom I met again after five years. Why has she changed so much?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“I want a wife as gentle as a rabbit and a daughter as cute as a mongoose.”*

On Christmas Eve, on my way home after making a wish to the mysterious Santa. But when I opened my eyes, I found myself in another world...?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

titles.title: I Became the First Prince: Legend of Sword's Song

description:
The dark blade Gruhorn, constant companion to heroes throughout the ages. Knights, rebels, and slayers—all became legend wielding this sentient blade. But, centuries after being claimed by the first hero, Gruhorn winds up in the clutches of his descendant: a greedy, greasy, bratty lout of a first prince. Even worse: when the prince falls onto the blade, Gruhorn becomes him! But is this new body a prison, or a chance for the legendary blade to become a hero himself?

(Source: Tapas)

เมนูเด็ดท่านเจ้าเมืองต่างโลก
異世界領主的美食饗宴

description:
Dominic, a war refugee who once lived as a nutritionist in a past life, settles in the small fishing village of Evergreen hoping for a quiet start. Instead, he is abruptly named village headman after the former leader steps down for the absurd reason that he refuses to learn how to read. Dominic’s nutritional and medical knowledge earns him unexpected attention when he diagnoses the former lord’s chronic foot pain through diet alone. His growing reputation soon draws the attention of the entire lord’s castle, changing his peaceful life forever.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: How to Survive as the Monster Duke's Wife
How to Survive as the Wife of the Monster Duke
Living to Survive as the Monster Duke's Wife
怪物公爵の妻になりました

description:
Duke Bifolten, the man whose gaze alone is said to freeze anyone’s entire body. Ilyin has a prophetic dream about spending her first night with him. Because she was shunned by everyone in the mansion for her prophetic dreams, Ilyin rarely ever stepped foot outside. To think she would spend her wedding night with Duke Bifolten, a man she’s never even seen. But is Duke Bifolten really such a dangerous person? ‘He was definitely kind that night.’ Why is Duke Bifolten—the man who rules over winter with his Authority and whose sword is faster than his words—gentle only with me?

*“If you see what I look like, you will never be able to leave this castle again, Ilyin.”* I just wanted to escape that house, but now, the Master of Winter is obsessed with me.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*"I pray every day that this love dies, that I may love you only until today, and that tomorrow this love will be dead."*

Thalia Roem Gürta, the ill-fated princess born of an affair. She grows up distorted amidst indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings, and servants who despise her. Thalia has protected herself by raising her thorns against everyone who approaches. Yet, even she becomes defenseless in the presence of one person. He is none other than the Prince of the East, Varkas Raedgo Sheerkan. Forced to be perfect as a retainer of the imperial court and the heir to the Grand Duke, he grew up with most of his emotions numb under discipline bordering on abuse. A man who exists solely for the honor and duty of his family. To keep a promise made to the late Empress, he enters into a marriage with Thalia's half-sister, Ayla, and Thalia, engulfed in despair, slowly falls apart. However, her love, destined for death, faces an unexpected turning point....

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
The cherished youngest daughter of the prestigious Jujak clan, Jeok Soya, is suddenly exposed as a fake.

“Strip her of her spirit core and lock her in the Cold Palace.”

Though her heart ached from her family’s cruelty and cold rejection, she endured it.
After all, she was just a wicked little fledgling who had deceived them and brought them sorrow.

“Please… get rid of that child.”

But even so, accepting death was a different matter entirely.

“What is this… little fluff ball?”

At the brink of danger, the one who saves Soya is a ferocious tiger—
No… the head of the Baekho clan.

“I think I’ll steal you, little fluff.”

Accepting his suspicious offer, Soya follows him to the land of Baekho.
She plans to live quietly, never drawing attention… but something about this clan is strange.

“Don’t worry, you’re no trouble at all. Stay here as long as you like.”

The clan head, infamous for his brutality, is unexpectedly gentle.

“Try calling me ‘Oppa,’ Soya.”
“Me too! I’m your oppa now, fluff ball!”

The young masters of the Baekho clan compete to become her older brothers.
And strangest of all—

“Our little fluff lady is just too adorable!”
“Hmph! Bet your old house didn’t have a fluff this cute, huh?”

“…Me? Cute? Not useless and dreadful?”

description:
Vivian awakens to find herself possessed into the body of a terminally ill female lead, doomed to a tragic ending. Refusing to accept her doom, Vivian seeks out Rahel, the story’s infamous villainess and the only person capable of curing her. What begins as a desperate gamble slowly turns into a genuine bond, and against all expectations, the two become close, true friends. But...

*"Not for a single moment did I ever consider you my friend, Vivian."

"Do you really think you could enter a contract marriage with anyone else?"*

...Wait. Wasn’t Rahel supposed to be a villainess?! My best friend just turned out to be a male?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
Grace, a girl who lost her parents and even her family, has held only one thing in her heart for 13 years: revenge. And then there’s Ares, who lost everything to the same enemy. Seeking revenge, Grace proposes a fake relationship with him, and the two enter into a cold pact. However, the feelings that sprout in the flames of revenge gradually blossom into love, and she fears that these feelings will become an obstacle to her revenge. Caught between revenge and love, what choice will these two make as they race towards the end?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Jay, a legendary hitman in America's underworld, is hired by Union, North America's largest assassin corporation, to destroy the assassin company founded by his friend Johnny with his own hands. The condition for accepting the job was sparing Johnny's life, but due to Union's betrayal, both Johnny and Jay are killed. However, resurrected by a mysterious power into the body of an ordinary young man in Korea, Jay meets Johnny, who has been resurrected in the body of a young woman. The two decide to join forces once more to create a powerful ‘company’ and exact revenge on Union, the organization that killed them.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

titles.title: The Black-Haired Grand Marshal of the U.S. Army

description:
Kim Yu-jin, in the second chapter of her life, retracing to the 1910s, conquers history with her future knowledge. A Korean company commander died trying to save a child from Letona, who was rolling down the hill. When I came to my senses, I had reverted to being Kim Yu-jin, a Korean-American in the 1900s, with knowledge of the future. Will those who know the future become chaebols, or will they?

description:
Lee Saehoon, the blacksmith of humanity’s last desperate united force, fought against the demons until the very end. However, the result was mutual destruction, with the world coming to an end. The moment he took his own life over that futile conclusion

*“…What is this?”*

He had regressed to his days as a candidate at the hero training institution, Babel Academy. Having obtained a second chance, he swore to use anything as material to gain victory this time. Anything at all!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
There was a nameless warrior who devoted his life to guarding and serving Cheon Mu-ryang, the eldest young master of the Cheon Clan. In the end, he was betrayed by Cheon Mu-ryang and met his death. But when he opened his eyes again, he found himself reborn as the very man who killed him: Cheon Mu-ryang, the infamous mad dog and eldest son of the Cheon Clan. With his memories of the past, his martial arts, and a cold, calculating judgment, he dons the mask of a scoundrel and steps into the clan’s internal struggles for power. From within, he begins to save the Cheon Clan from destruction... To rewrite the future itself.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*In a season when cherry blossom petals scatter on the dry wind, I fell in love with a pale faced poet. My first experience of unrequited love was like a fever.
Each time I suffered from it, I caught my heated breath and quietly sank into misery. Yet that spring was undeniably the most lyrical season of my life.*

Baek Seonghyeon, a poor working student, returns to university with a completely ruined timetable after getting the course registration date wrong. Forced to attend even a literature class he has no interest in, he looks up the course withdrawal period and happens to notice a note taking job posting on campus. Twice a week, a monthly pay of 1.5 million won. Without a second thought, Baek Seonghyeon sends in his application.

Never once imagining that there, he would meet a poet who would completely upend his life.

---

description:
Unkillable. Unstoppable. Still hunted. Ji-O, a “Heart Mutant” with the Heart of Resurrection, escaped ten years of brutal experimentation, but freedom doesn’t last. With a body that can regenerate from any injury, he’s a target the world won’t ignore. The moment he finds something worth protecting, and even a sliver of a normal life, it’s threatened all over again by the very lab that tortured him and his friends. But this time, Ji-O is done running.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Nam Eun-ho, a college student living alone with his younger sister, has lived a life of extreme misfortune, beginning with a childhood car accident. Eun-ho's sole goal is to live an ordinary life, remaining unnoticed. Then, one day, a campus goddess, unexpectedly entangled with him, strikes him with a sudden urge! Is this a stroke of luck, or the start of yet another misfortune?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:
*“Welcome to the world of the Mad Moon!”*

After losing his entire family to vampires, Segun is reborn as a vampire hunter. Will he become a vampire, or die as a human? In Seoul, a brutal battle unfolds between vampires and hunters. The curtain rises on an epic, blood-soaked finale!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

titles.title: กาลเหมันต์

description:
Ever since being disowned by his religious parents for being gay, Kwon Yi-Hyeon has been all alone. After nine years, he believes he has gotten used to this life until he runs into Gu Seung-Hyeok, an old wound from high school. Now a ruthless gangster, Seung-Hyeok is just as cold to Yi-Hyeon as the winter they have reunited in. But when Yi-Hyeon enters a contract deal with Seung-Hyeok due to his financial troubles, perhaps their frosty relationship could turn into hope of a spring to come...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Alpha Jo Yeon-Oh, the extreme right-winger and heir to the Haesung Foundation, and Beta So Gi-Hyeon, his childhood friend who had long watched over him from the sidelines while nurturing his love alone. The seemingly solid bond between them begins to crack with Gi-Hyeon's confession. The moment he revealed his long-held affection, Yeon-Oh responded with an insulting, disgusted retort.

 *“You've forgotten you're a Beta, haven't you?”*

An Alpha who physiologically despises dating a Beta. Faced with this harsh, painful rebuke, Gi-Hyeon quietly tries to let go, but Yeon-Oh rejects even that. Jo Yeon-Oh, revealing his selfish obsession and controlling tendencies toward what he cherishes, refuses to allow Gi-Hyeon to distance himself.

 *“Fine. Let's do it. Dating. You fucking selfish bastard.”*

What he chose instead of severing ties was the start of a deceitful relationship. But since it was Yeon-Oh's choice too, Gi-Hyeon accepted it.

 *“If you really can't stand it, I said I'd find someone for you. Try to stick with omegas if possible.”*

Yeon-Oh's cruel consideration, suggesting sleep with others even while dating. Gi-Hyeon, whose heart was being indifferently carved up, also reaches his limit. Yet, at the end of his excruciating unrequited love, Gi-Hyeon faces a physical change he never believed possible. Jo Yeon-Oh, the possessive, twisted obsessive who denies his feelings, and Gi-Hyeon, who stoically swallowed his wounds until he finally chose to flee. Where will the diverging paths of these two ultimately lead?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

He wipes them all out in one satisfying sweep! The rookie days of the monster detective, Ma Seok-Do! A covert operation begins to take down the worst and strongest crime syndicate.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Creating a secret milking recipe by a dairy farmer's son with exceptional milking skills and a cafe owner who produces breast milk.

She got married young, at just twenty. After four years of one-sided love, all that remained was her husband’s affair. So she made a decision— to cheat back. Drunk out of her mind, she spends the night with a man whose face she doesn’t even know. But why are you worried about my husband ?

 "Does your husband know you’re doing this ? Don’t you ever think about your husband ? Don’t you feel sorry for him at all ? "

Somehow, it turns into an affair entangled with her husband as well— Marriage Scam.

*“Wanna suck me off?”*

Ji-Han gets caught by Shin-U having a crush on a guy. To keep it a secret, Ji-Han ends up facing sexual demands he never imagined from Shin-U. To make matters worse, when a stalker targets Shin-U—his bodyguard client and a popular star—they end up living under the same roof...

Kim Shin-U, the spoiled younger man who acts however he pleases, and Ji-Han, who resents him yet finds himself helplessly swept along. How will their tangled relationship ever untangle?

description:
Tae-Mi, the spoiled daughter of a chaebol family, not only repeatedly botched new ventures but also caused a major scandal with her clueless social media posts. Ultimately, at her furious father's command, Tae-Mi is demoted to Sunchang-ri, the chili pepper capital. A city girl through and through, Tae-mi screams at the sight of the remote village before her. But meeting Kang-Hun, a young farmer and breathtakingly handsome man living in a watermill at the edge of a chili field, instantly recharges her motivation. Soon, after accidentally witnessing Kang-Hun's well-built lower body and striking beauty, she throws caution to the wind and begins aggressively pursuing him... .!

A spicy-sweet, farm-fresh romance straight from the countryside!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A hundred children were trapped on Hengshan. Only one walked out alive—a boy named Dan Hyeongwoo. He survived the hell created by the Cheon Gija and gained power worthy of being called that of a demon god in return. But the world felt unfamiliar to him, and its rules made no sense... So, he becomes an escort warrior of the Henan Escort Agency, relearning what people are and what the world is from the ground up. Everything he does is for one single purpose: the day he will take revenge on Cheon Gija.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I transmigrated into a crazy novel and came to possess the body of ‘Roella’, a fake saintess who’s destined to die young. A moment of despair. A determined plan to survive. 

When the real saintess comes out, I’ll just say, ‘I knew it, I guess I’m a fake!’ then stand down! The perfect plan provided a moment’s repose. 

Ding—!

Mối Tình Vượt Quá Giới Hạn

description:
It seems my brother’s fiancée is having an affair with a coworker. Determined to stop the wedding within two months, Ian goes undercover, taking a job as the personal secretary to the CEO of the company where her future sister-in-law works.

*"Do you think boundaries exist just to be crossed?"*

Unfortunately for her, that CEO is Cha Jeonghan, a man as strikingly handsome as he is utterly unbearable. With his cutting remarks and infuriating composure, he makes it his personal mission to provoke Ian at every turn.

*"Yes. Boundaries exist to be crossed."*

With nothing to lose, not even her job, Ian decides to trample over Jeonghan’s carefully drawn lines whenever she pleases. And slowly, the once-arrogant man who never deigned to look down from his lofty pedestal begins to falter.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The criminal organization disrupting the city's order. Do Hyun-Woo, the hound deployed to uncover the secrets of the Black Cloud Society. Infiltrating was fine, but for some reason, a figure named Team Leader Ha began obstructing Hyun-Woo's every move. 

 *“Well, I'm just a beta, you know?!”

“This is weird. But why does this smell so damn tempting?”*

Team Leader Ha, who invades even his personal space, causes complications in the undercover operation...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The strongest man of the Murim, “Asura,” got transported to another world. Having reached the pinnacle through his martial capabilities alone, he smashes the status window and the tower with his own hands—rejecting participation as a player outright.

display_title: The Queen Who Deserves to Be Tainted

titles.title: The Queen Who Deserves to Be Tainted

description:
Through a political marriage with an enemy nation, Elfreda has become the queen of the kingdom. The only one welcoming the queen of barbarian descent is the assassin sent to kill her. In that life-or-death moment, Elfreda falls in love at first sight with her husband, Ainar, who saved her, and gradually becomes deeply enamored with him. Meanwhile, Ainar, who had married Elfreda from the start solely to use her as the granddaughter of his enemy, also finds himself unwittingly falling for the pure and lovely Elfreda... 

Even though she knows she is not loved by him, and even though he knows he must not love her, the two are drawn to each other. Will this love end in ruin?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Life as the Grand Duke's Daughter-in-Law Is Too Easy

titles.title: Life as the Grand Duke's Daughter-in-Law Is Too Easy
Life in the Duke's Household Is Too Easy
The Marriage Life in the Grand Duke Family Is Surprisingly Easy
The Marriage Life in the Grand Duke Family Is Too Easy, Though

description:
I possessed the body of my favorite character’s former wife, the one who dies young, in my all time favorite novel.

*“I didn’t have any lingering regrets from my past life anyway, so whatever. Since it’s come to this, I might as well enjoy stanning my favorite to my heart’s content.”*

That was what I thought, but I survived because a power that never existed in the original story awakened within me. On top of that, somewhere along the way, I ended up winning over my in laws far too easily.

*“You are probably the only person who would risk their life for Akid’s favourably more than for a commission.”*

My free spirited, utterly dysfunctional father in law even helps support my fangirling.

*“Then you should not have been born so cute. There are plenty of vicious criminals in this world who prey on children as adorable as you.”*

My mother in law, once known as the Mad Dog of Heint, does not treat me coldly at all. Instead, she goes to extremes to protect me. And then there is my husband, who used to be nothing but innocent, suddenly starting to flirt with me at every opportunity.

*“Roena’s hair is just like cotton candy.”

“My hair is a bit frizzy, though.”

“Not at all. I meant it is so soft that I want to keep touching it.”*

All this time, I thought I was someone dangerous to him. But then…

*“Roena, do you have any idea now who is more dangerous?”*

Could it be that my Akid, whom I thought was only pure and naive, was actually a genius at flirting all along?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

รถไฟขบวนสุดท้ายสู่ขุมนรก

description:
Exhausted after a grueling day at work, Ham Yegyeong drifts into a light sleep during her chaotic evening subway commute. Her peaceful rest is violently shattered when the man sitting next to her, who had seemingly offered his shoulder for her to lean on, suddenly thrusts his middle finger deep into her private opening. Jolted awake and paralyzed by terror, she can barely squeeze out a desperate whisper: .

*"S-stop, please stop...".*

The predator only offers a cold, mocking smirk.

*"Stop what?".

"If you stop, I'll... I'll just pretend this never happened, aaah!"*.

Yegyeong gasps, her plea cut short as his touch grows even more invasive. To her absolute horror, the nightmare escalates. As she looks up through tears, she realizes that the crowd is shifting, and a group of completely unfamiliar men are slowly closing in, surrounding her seat to seal her fate. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Can men and women be friends? YES or NO?

Gu Do-eun, collector of duds.
The boyfriend she trusted got caught rolling around in bed with another woman, leading to their breakup. 

To make matters worse, her flat renovation coincided, leaving her with nowhere to stay! In the midst of her mental breakdown, childhood friend Han-ju proposes they live together...

Born from the weaponization of nuclear fusion technology, the superhuman weapons known as Defiers (D-fire) plunged the world into war—an apocalypse that wiped out 30% of humanity. The survivors came to loathe the Defiers, branding them the architects of extinction and calling them “Enders.”Theo, the sole survivor among the Enders, lived for 30 years under the surveillance of the Ainex Alliance, his core removed, passing his days as an ordinary family man. But when the anti-nuclear terrorist organization “Zero Core” attacks, Theo loses his wife—and his daughter Louise vanishes without a trace. The peace he struggled to protect is shattered in an instant.Vowing revenge, Theo reawakens the forbidden power he sealed away three decades ago to reclaim his daughter. Standing against Zero Core’s vast conspiracy and a world steeped in prejudice, the lonely battle of the last Ender begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

titles.title: Khúc Blues Hoa Bồ Công Anh

description:
Park Kang-tae, having inherited the debts of the Naksan faction, moves to Seoul. Through the grandson who sold him an empty house for a bargain, Kang-tae ends up moving into the main residence of 'Big Brother' and meets Joo Yeon-hee, who introduces herself as a housekeeper. 

"I came to help with the cleaning..." 

It was an extremely rare occurrence for him, who had always been engrossed only in his work, to develop an interest in a woman. What exactly was this sense of déjà vu? Was the feeling of having met sometime before just a simple coincidence?

description:
The novel Evelyn Florence wakes up in has an 18+ rating for a totally different reason than one would expect. It is all because of the story’s psychopathic villain, Duke Cael Hartheon, who goes on to torture the female lead in unspeakable ways. But a bad drunken night results in Evelyn getting tied up with the literal worst character in the novel. Now forced into an impending marriage, Evelyn will do whatever she can to make Cael sick of her and leave her first. But if only the blood-red duke didn’t turn out to be such a green flag...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

description:
Before Aisha’s father passes away, he leaves his daughter his vast fortune on the condition that she finds a husband in six months. Skeptical of love and surrounded by greedy debt-ridden relatives, Aisha decides to simply buy a husband with money. Her search for a commoner with nothing to his name leads her to the strikingly handsome jockey, Weiz. However, Weiz doesn't seem like a normal commoner, with his commanding presence and mysterious ties to the imperial family. As her calculated business deal turns into a heated exchange, Aisha realizes she may have bought more than she bargained for.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: The sixth story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.*

After her mother’s death, Louise is left destitute with her only inheritance being a mysterious pearl. Unaware of its immense value as an imperial heirloom, Louise attempts to pawn it to fund her mother’s burial. However, Crown Prince Cauis, disguised as the Margrave of Burg ever since he was betrayed by Louise’s mother, manipulates Louise to have her pay for her dead mother’s sins. Trapped in a conspiracy of seduction, politics, and revenge, Louise must decide if she can trust Caius with both her heart and the Pearl of Albrecht.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.*

Sa-Rang Yu, a second-year in high school, has never really fit in. She isn’t exactly bullied, but her classmates keep singling her out, even pushing the dares from their humiliation games onto her. No one says it out loud, but everyone senses something seriously off about her as the games take on a darker, more unsettling edge. Will these games help Sa-rang finally find acceptance among her peers, or will the escalating dares reveal the twisted side everyone suspects is already there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
Although she was born into the renowned House Arachne, poor Riersha is shunned by her family for not having powers like them. But when a previously loyal aide betrays House Arachne, she learns her family was actually trying to protect her all along...! Once she dies by the aide's sword, Riersha wakes up in the past as a four-year-old and discovers that she does have a special power, although she's not quite sure what it does. Now, little Riersha must save her family by getting the traitorous aide on her side and using her mysterious power to protect them... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

description:
A serial killer is staging corpses as “self-destruction art” and selling them to the ultra-wealthy for tens of millions. When failed artist Suchan Kim recognizes the concept as his own—stolen from an exhibition the world laughed into oblivion—his obsession with proving this mutates into something darker: a hunger for the recognition he never received. In a world where spectacle is worth more than life, will Suchan expose the killer, or become part of the masterpiece?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Trapped in a loveless marriage to Count Macleod, Evelyn survives neglect and humiliation, finding refuge in her art. Everything changes when her husband’s mistress arrives with her son, Jay. Stolen glances ignite a dangerous bond—one that could shatter Evelyn’s marriage and leave Jay entangled in his mother’s schemes.

(Source: Manta)

description:
Greta, a commoner, has spent her life believing that love means little without money or status. Shaped by her parents’ failed marriage and her father’s obsession with nobility, she sees marriage as the surest way to rise above her station. Edmund, a noble, believes the opposite. Having grown up watching his parents preserve their love despite hardship, he despises Greta’s view of love and ambition. When two people with completely opposing beliefs become entangled in the world of theater, will their convictions remain unchanged—or will it make them to question what they truly believe? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: Au fin fond de la déception
พรางรักใต้เงาลวง

description:
Lee Jeong-Yeon lost everything the day his lover died saving a stranger. A stranger none other than, Ki Seo-Hyeok, the boy Jeong-Yeon once taught. Drowning in grief and haunted by the unfairness of his loss, Jeong-Yeon seeks out the Seo-Hyeok, driven by a desperate need to see the life that was bought with his lover's blood. But as Seo-Hyeok begins to fill the empty spaces in Jeong-Yeon's life, the mourning teacher realizes that some debts are paid in ways more dangerous than death.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: The Girlfriend Who's Been Targeting My Body for 10 Years

description:
I have these childhood friends... But were we ever just friends?

(Source: Toomics)

Ju Sung-Hyeon has it all: the looks, the grades, and a flawless reputation. But his fast track to a golden future hits a massive speed bump when his family drags him to a middle-of-nowhere village. The uniforms are tacky, the locals are worse, and to top it all off, someone else is sitting in his throne as the school’s top student! Enter Park Chan-Woo, a born-and-bred country boy who doesn’t care about Sung-Hyeon’s city prestige. But when Sung-Hyeon confronts his new rival to reclaim his pride, Chan-Woo offers a deal he never expected: "If you want to talk, help me with the harvest first."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Han Tae-Oh’s return to Korea was supposed to be a brief, somber visit to bury his father. Instead, he finds himself trapped in a web of suspicion centered on Yun Gyeong-Seo, the man who stayed behind to serve his family while Tae-Oh was away. Gossip whispers of Gyeong-Seo’s involvement in his father’s decline, and the more Tae-Oh investigates, the less he recognizes his former first love. Within the walls of the sprawling mansion, Tae-Oh begins to piece together a fragmented past, uncovering a cycle of revenge that has been decades in the making. Every truth he unearths brings him closer to a terrifying realization: the person he wants to trust most may be the one who has everything to lose.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
*"You'd better apologize before I sue you for sexual harassment."*

Matthew has always worked harder than anyone else at his company, where most of the employees are women. Despite that, all he received from his coworkers was derision and ridicule. One day, after suffering humiliation from his female coworkers, he decides to seize an investment opportunity that comes his way, kick- starting a new and exciting chapter of his life.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Tired of the city, I moved to the countryside for a quiet life. But now... everyone I see has a number on their chest!

(Source: Toomics)

Drunk as a skunk, transfer student Moon Yeon-Su stumbles home and accidentally enters the apartment below his only to find the door code matches his. There, he witnesses his department teaching assistant, Yun Do-Ah, and his classmate, Hong Yi-Jae, in the act. The night passes amid this shocking scene, and the next day, Yeon-Su belatedly realizes his misdeed...

 *"... What the hell? Isn't that the pervert from yesterday?"*

But unable to forget the pleasure of that night, Yeon-Su encounters the pair again, and thus begins his chaotic, lewd college life!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

titles.title: พรางรักในคืนพร

description:

description:
Demian, a boy raised in an orphanage, discovers that his benefactor was actually his biological father. To escape the shadow of his father’s family, he throws himself into a foreign war.  

On the desolate battlefield—where he has no reason to survive, no goals to pursue—one day he receives a letter, gentle as a spring breeze:   
“Hello, soldier whose name and face I do not know. I’m delighted that fate has connected us this way. I am a lady from a humble family living in the countryside with beautiful scenery. I’m not anyone remarkable, so I don’t have much to introduce myself with.”  

The noblewoman introduces herself as Lintrey. What begins as a chance pen pal relationship gradually becomes Demian’s only solace, and the woman beyond the letters becomes his first reason to want to live.  

Later, Demian is discharged after an unexpected accident. He travels to the address from the letters to find his pen pal, but…  

“That house burned down in a huge fire not long ago.”   
“If the Lintrey you’re talking about is the maid from that house, then she’s dead.”   

A burned mansion. Conflicting testimonies…  
Did Lady Lintrey ever really exist, or was it all a lie from the beginning?  

Confused and shaken, Demian clings to a faint hope that she cannot be dead and heads to the capital city of Nihiro to search for her.  

Will Demian be able to meet Lintrey again in that place?

And will he finally receive an answer to the words he never got to say?

**[A 100-Night Challenge Between a Farmer and a Worm Asking to Share Yang Energy]**

The only occupants of a shabby, one-room thatched hut were the farmer Nongbu and a white dog. Nongbu made a living by renting land from a well-known local landlord, and after another long day of plowing his fields, he returned home and wrapped up his day.

*“Haah….”*

Exhausted from farm work, Nongbu fell into a deep sleep... But suddenly, a strange, moan-like sound echoed through the room. The odd thing was, he was the only person inside. Kicking off his worn blanket, the only one he owned, mended by the wife of his neighbor and only friend Gaecheol, the farmer twisted in distress.

It was impossible to tell what was tormenting him. Soon, the ties of his thin undergarment came undone, exposing his bare skin. Tossing and turning across his bedding, the farmer broke out in a cold sweat, letting out soft moans again and again.

Just who is tormenting 22-year-old Hong Nongbu every night? To answer that, we must go back to the daytime, ninety-nine days earlier.

My dad is a noble? I have a rich grandfather?!

My relatives didn’t give my father a warm welcome after his six-years absence; instead, they pierced him with cold, hostile glares. n that moment, strange scenes began to surface my mind like a torrential rainstorm.

Berry, you must be careful of the relatives. Travel is a den of beasts, all hunting for the position of family head.

Lady Berry! News has arrived… Young Master Reitan has been killed in action!

Seven years old, ten years old, sixteen years old…
They were all me, yet they were memories I didn’t remember.
And in every single one of those memories, my father met a meaningless, tragic death.

***

This… this can’t possibly be real.

“Head Butler, did you recently purchase a large amount of stock in an ink company that’s about to go bankrupt?”
“That company would never go bust… Wait, how did you know I bought those stocks?”

Ack! That was exactly right, too!

If these memories are real, then this time, I will save my father no matter what.

But I can’t do this alone.
I need an ally who will be my greatest pillar of support.
Fortunately, there is a hidden gem that only I know of.

My first plan is to make that young boy my ally.

In a world where gods and humans coexist, there is a land called Rawon (羅園). The gods here survive by feeding on the reverence of humans, and in return use that power to protect them. Humans, meanwhile, live their lives under the gods’ grace, bound together in a “cycle of reverence and blessing.”

Yusa, the river god of Cheongyugang, has refused human reverence for nearly a century after losing his beloved human disciple, Tan’eo. Whenever he comes close to losing his divinity and fading into a lesser creature, he barely prolongs his fragile existence by borrowing divine power through “hapshin,” a union with the mountain god Gaho, who secretly harbors feelings for him.

Meanwhile, Dajin, the son of a great general whose entire clan was slaughtered by an evil god, longs to become an “Inje” — a human emperor chosen by the gods — for the sole purpose of revenge. Confident in his exceptional martial skill, he asks to become Gaho’s disciple, but Gaho sees through the vengeance consuming his heart and rejects him. Driven into despair by the belief that the gods abandoned both his parents and himself, Dajin ultimately throws himself into the Cheongyu River.

Wishing that no more humans connected to him would die, Yusa saves Dajin by passing on the last of his remaining divinity through a kiss, exhausting his own strength in the process. When Dajin awakens, he dismisses Yusa’s actions as mere whimsy and lashes out in anger. Demanding that Yusa take the divine power back, he impulsively kisses him in return.

In that fleeting moment of contact, the two share each other’s wounds and true feelings, unintentionally forming a master-disciple contract. Through “hapshin,” the act of exchanging divine power, Yusa gains the vitality needed to survive, while Dajin obtains the strength he needs for revenge.

A god unable to escape the scars of the past, and a human willing to risk his life for vengeance. As Rawon’s greatest competition, the Jeseonje (帝選祭), approaches for the first time in a hundred years, their desperate yet sensual tale of salvation begins.

description:
The man who raised me as his own daughter was murdered. Deciding to use my save&reload ability, I turned back time to a previous safe point. The problem is, out of my four time slots, he’s only alive in the one where I’m seven. Welp, it is what it is. Repeating some life is no biggie, so let’s start over. Elysion, giving off a weird vibe, pulled me aside. He’d been a close friend even pre-reset. Is this happening? 

[Overwriting Time Slot 1 with current point.] 

“I love you, Tania. I’ve liked you for a long time.” 

“Ah, I’m finally getting a confession…!” 

Overcome with excitement, I immediately loaded the save point so I could hear his confession again. 

[Time Slot 1 Loaded.] 

[Time Slot 1 Loaded.] 

[Time Slot 1 Load…] 

[Time Slot 1 …….] 

I’m not sure how many times I replayed his confession. Elysion’s face turned so red that it looked about ready to burst; he parted his lips with a troubled look. 

“Tania. If you want, I can tell you as many times as you’d like, but could you at least give me an answer to my confession first?” 

“What…?” 

Shockingly, he remembered everything I did. Instantly, everything I’d done in front of him flashed through my mind. Like, I would often look at his face, muttering to myself about how handsome he was. And how every time I wanted to see him, I would go up to him and touch him, making him distressed. And most importantly, how I had just turned back the clock by twelve freaking years just because I wanted to. I really didn’t think he would end up remembering all of that.

description:
There are many pirates in the world.

The hierarchy among pirates is determined by two things: the bounty on their heads, dictated by their notoriety, and their strength.

Daphne, a pirate recognized as the strongest in both aspects, one day spends a night with a navy officer.

As dawn breaks, the night comes to an end.

Even as she leaves behind the sleeping officer, she never once considers the possibility of meeting him again in the future.

If they were ever to cross paths again, it would be best not to face him head-on.

You’re in no position to be making accusations. If I had known you’d act like this, I should have just killed you.

But she never expected to reunite like this.

The man standing before her now bore almost no resemblance to the composed yet gentlemanly figure from that night.

So.

You should have just killed me instead.

It was only upon hearing those words that Daphne finally admitted it to herself.

She had become entangled—completely, inescapably—with the very royal hound she so despised.
